name: com.stayflexhotel/day-use-hotels
title: Stayflex Hotel
description: Day-use hotel rooms in France, starting at Paris-CDG: live availability, exact prices, booking link.

tools.name: search_day_use
tools.description: Search Stayflex for hotel rooms bookable for a few hours during the day (day use, no overnight stay), with live availability and the exact price that will be charged, taxes included. Stayflex partner hotels are in France: around Paris-Charles de Gaulle airport (airport "CDG", for instance for a layover, an early arrival or a late flight) or in a given town. Returns, for each hotel with a free room for the requested slot, the rooms and their prices, the day-use packages sold that day, and a pre-filled link to the hotel's Stayflex page where the traveler books and pays. Read-only: it books and charges nothing.

airport.description: Airport area: "CDG" = Paris-Charles de Gaulle (Roissy). Used by default when neither airport nor city is given.

city.description: French town name of the hotel, e.g. "Tremblay-en-France", instead of an airport. Case, accents and hyphens do not matter.

date.description: Day of the stay, YYYY-MM-DD (Paris local date).

checkIn.description: Arrival time HH:MM, Paris local time, on a 30-minute grid from 08:30; the stay must end by 22:00. Defaults to 10:00.

durationHours.description: Desired length of stay in hours. Hotels sell fixed packages (for example 3, 6 or 10 h): the request is rounded up to the next package. Defaults to the shortest package.

guests.description: Number of guests sharing the room. Defaults to 1.

language.description: Language of the Stayflex web pages linked in the result: "en" (default) or "fr".

tools.name: get_hotel
tools.description: Get the details of a hotel bookable for day use on Stayflex: where it is and how to get there, star category and guest rating, the day-use packages it sells on a given date with their lowest prices (taxes included), room types and their capacity, booking rules (arrival hours, minimum notice), cancellation terms, and links to its Stayflex page. Identify the hotel by the slug or id returned by search_day_use, or by its name. Live availability for a precise time slot comes from search_day_use.

hotel.description: Hotel slug or id from search_day_use (e.g. "sheraton-paris-cdg-airport-tremblay-en-france"), or the hotel name.

date.description: Day used for the packages and prices, YYYY-MM-DD (Paris local date). Defaults to today in Paris.

language.description: Language of the Stayflex web pages linked in the result: "en" (default) or "fr".
